selection_and_limits: Full corrected-cap policy beat reduced network policy 4-2 in a direct six-game comparison; retained as selected configuration.
Selected source scores 14-20 against uploaded submission 14928 across 17 maps, seed 853, both colours. This does not establish improvement over that upload.
Metered selected comparison scores 4-4 across four maps, seed 854; zero action errors and peak 75,778,850 instructions.
Same-seed aggressive comparison scores 4-4; prior upload scored 5-3 against that reference on the same eight fixtures. No claim of competitive superiority.
Reduced corrected-cap network policy scored 17-17 on another 17-map seed and 2-6 in its metered comparison; different-seed broad results do not directly rank the variants.

Phase expansion is disabled: isolated expansion scored 2-4 and failed to increase population or income. The earlier 5-1 no-phase ablation was incomplete because the off branch retained experimental crowding; resource-cap rollback was subsequently corrected and tested.

Controlled feeding is disabled: corrected opt-in comparison scored 3-3 with zero qualifying transfers. Engine recovery is verified in conformance, but match benefit is unproven. The early feeding run predates an emission fix and is superseded.
Native comparisons are unmetered and provide no CPU guarantee; CPU evidence comes from the sandbox comparison.
Determinism consists of four unique fixtures repeated twice (eight executions), with identical replay bytes in every pair.
Public leader replay observations informed changes; local frozen opponents are not current private leader implementations.
